objective: Room 6 (cdb7ced5-b67f-4f94-8639-0257a1dd8e9a) as a testbed: render the whole room without gaps using ElevenLabs-generated materials.

findings.scan_holes: Room 6 LiDAR scan has no surface over 25% of wall area and 63% of floor area (5 cm grid, 6 cm tolerance); colour cannot fill holes, so the gapless view is the box model (scene.glb).
findings.box_model_coverage: Photos reach 48% of the box model's texels; the other 52% now take room materials.
findings.tinting: Tinting room-generated materials to the photographed median made a wall mid-grey (dark projected shapes pulled the median down); room materials now keep their own colour, generic ones are still tinted.

phases.name: outlet discovery on room 6
phases.notes: 99 photos read, 11 objects; added as revision 2: 1 outlet, 1 candidate outlet, television, sofa, 2 whiteboards. Needs Settings.from_environment() for .env keys and SSL_CERT_FILE=certifi bundle (python.org Python has no CA store).

phases.name: material keys per labelled object + shared fill core
box model (atlas) fill for unphotographed texels
room-matched materials from photo crops via gpt-image-2 inline references
phases.notes: 8 materials: chair, floor, front door, table, television, wall, whiteboard, window. Outlet and sofa skipped: fewer than 200 photographed points each.

phases.name: rebuild room 6 textures and render before/after
step 1: patch LiDAR holes in walls and floor with their planes
phases.notes: Room 6: 17.5 m2 of patches; 23% coloured by a photo, 77% by room materials. Walls and floor inside the walls have no gaps left except door and window (cut_into) openings. Photo colour is refused where a measured object box stands between camera and patch (stops chair colour leaking onto floor). Floor patches stay inside the hull of the wall ends.
